messages:
Zara (Product): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A on customer wins/losses. I want a short, usable summary we can hand to sales + eng. Drop one-line notes.
Kofi (Head of Sales): Win: payments infra vendor picked Dedicated bc of our token-level cost dashboard and predictable throughput. Loss: gov contractor chose on-prem vendor for strict data residency + FIPS/HSM requirements.
Linh (CS): Common asks across lost deals: 1) customer-managed keys 2) longer retention for audit logs 3) certified attestation packs 4) clear Private deployment checklist.
Omar (SE): Technical win story: per-route model pinning + automatic fallback kept a demo running during a model drift test. Customers loved the rollback knob.
Omar (SE): Loss detail: a telecom POC failed compliance because our default retention = 90 days; they wanted 7 years and a pre-approved KMS flow.
Priya (Security): We can scope a temporary attestation for sales but need Product to define scope + expiration. Long-term: support for customer KMS + FIPS endpoints.
Ellen (CEO): Tactical priorities (next 60d): - attestation template for sales - audit checklist + sample answers - Dedicated vs Private one-pager that lists controls. Strategic (quarter): customer KMS, retention tiers, on-prem packaging.
Zara (Product): Action items: Kofi -> list top 10 lost deals with the exact blocker (48h). Omar -> draft warm-pool + cache-warming runbook for p99 tail (72h). Priya -> attestation template draft (48h). Linh -> audit checklist draft (72h).
Kofi (Head of Sales): Will include rep notes + customer quotes. Also flag 3 strategic accounts for expedited attestation review.
Priya (Security): Noted. I'll add a simple decision matrix for when to approve scoped attestations.
SyncBot: Reminder set: "Enterprise blocker triage" Thu 09:30 PT. GH project created: https://go.redwood/gh/ah-wins-losses-1742102468
Zara (Product): Thanks. Please keep replies terse so we can turn this into an owner-led GH project. Follow-up sync scheduled after the GH draft is up. :rocket:
